verification: Rebuilt 30 PALAGAN-owned material node trees from output/material_palette.json and re-rendered CAM_KEMBANG_STREET and CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW (1400x900, EEVEE, map underlay hidden). Inspected before/after crops of the shopfront band: glazing changed from a flat black void to a graduated blue-grey sheen (sampled RGB about 44,51,55 rising with grazing angle) and the interior plane behind it is now a lit warm grey instead of near-black. Facades were rebuilt from the shared plaster texture set with a multiply tint that keeps the texture's tonal detail; the earlier luminance-ramp version had flattened the walls to flat colour. Terrace and landmark roofs now use the clay tile diffuse/rough/normal set at a 5.5 m repeat with a low-frequency weathering multiply so the tile grid does not read as an obvious repeated pattern. Footway setts were desaturated from red brick to grey paving and rescaled from about 0.7 m to about 1.2 m per texture tile. Open ground changed from pale sand to a muted earth-green so empty land no longer reads as desert, and road aggregate/track roughness was added. EEVEE raytracing options raised (screen_trace_quality 0.5, resolution_scale 2, trace_max_roughness 0.55) and taa_render_samples 64. Defects still visible and deferred: shopfront bays remain one unbroken pane per bay because bay mullion geometry is a construction change, and daylight is still flat with no sky gradient. Four materials were skipped because they do not exist in this scene (MAT_ROOF_CLAY, MAT_SINGA_*, etc. resolved where present).
